description:
Lawful development: Existing use.
The application seeks a Lawful Development Certificate in respect of existing operational development comprising the removal and replacement of deteriorated roof structures to the main workshop building at 51A Hillside Road, Tottenham, London N15 6LU.

The works involved:

• Removal of structurally compromised east and west roof sections due to water ingress and timber decay.
• Renewal of supporting timber joists and structural members.
• Localised rebuilding of 1–3 courses of brickwork where damaged by prolonged water penetration.
• Reconfiguration of the east and west roof sections to mono-pitch arrangements to improve drainage performance.
• Installation of new roof boarding and hot-welded asphalt roof finishes.

The central pitched roof section, with a maximum ridge height of approximately 5.6 meters above Finished Floor Level, remains unchanged.

The overall building footprint remains unaltered.
No increase in maximum building height has occurred.
The works were completed in February 2026.

The building continues to operate as a commercial motor repair and MOT workshop.
